question: Which among the following glaciers is not located in Jammu & Kashmir?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Milam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Milam Glacier is not located in Jammu & Kashmir.**
 
• It is found in the state of** Uttarakhand, India.**
 
• **The glacier is situated on the eastern side of Nanda Devi.**
 
• The other glaciers - **Bhillan, Thajiwas, and Prui - are located in Jammu & Kashmir.**
